name: Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells polyester filament and staple fiber. The company offers semi-dull flat polyester pre-oriented yarn; DTY, FDY, and POY composite series; original solution coloring; staple fiber; polyester slice; and purified terephthalic acid. It also provides moisture wicking fiber, hollow thermal fiber, flame retardant fiber, polyester imitation cotton, comfortable flat fiber, and antibacterial fiber. Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tongxiang, China.
